_comment: Extra retrieval synonym groups. Each inner list is a set of words a caller might use for the SAME thing; any of them then finds passages that use any other. Names only - this file never contains answers. Point RAG_SYNONYMS_PATH at your copy of this file; it is re-read when it changes. Built-in groups (Lumpy Skin Disease, symptoms, spread, prevention, vaccine, treatment, milk, meat, fever, lumps, flies, disease, skin, cow, buffalo, animal, vet) always apply.
